The UTF-8/count/total witness covers all four bounded-element text-list spellings. Generated Go and JavaScript independently confirm the expected prefix. Wire and JSON both report ten clamps: an element clamped at its length, the element that carries the sum past the total, and a count past [..N], each counted, including the element past [..N] that the total had already dropped (docs/SPEC-TABLES.md §2.13). Writers reject stored totals past five bytes. Absent and present-empty optional elements consume zero bytes.
